name: Femboy Apocalypse
source: Femboy Apocalypse is an adult visual novel set in a world rebuilding after a mysterious transformation. Follow Alex as he grows close to Haven's femboy and futanari residents, adjusts to a new life, and uncovers the secrets of The Bloom.
translation: 《伪娘启示录》（Femboy Apocalypse）是一款成人视觉小说，舞台设在一场神秘异变后逐步重建的世界。跟随亚历克斯的脚步，与避风港（Haven）里的伪娘及扶他居民们日渐亲近，适应崭新的生活，并揭开“绽放”（The Bloom）背后的秘密。
